mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 2100 units signals increased consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 2100.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 3.5% eases monetary conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment (UNRATE) rises by > 0.3pp in 3 months, it signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 6-month moving average signals strengthening supply chains, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 50% of instances when INDPRO > 6-month MA.

mechanism_narrative: The joint behavior of rising GDP (GDPC1) and increasing retail sales (RSAFS) signals robust consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window when both GDPC1 and RSAFS rise.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) increase above 4% tightens monetary conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during late-cycle expansions.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 50% of late-cycle instances when FEDFUNDS > 4%.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of low unemployment (UNRATE < 5%) and rising payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals a strong labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window when UNRATE < 5% and PAYEMS rises.

mechanism_narrative: A CPI (CPIAUCSL) increase above its 12-month moving average, coupled with rising housing starts (HOUST), signals inflationary pressures and robust demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 12-month MA and HOUST > 2000.
